verdict.rationale: Qodo documents natural-language operation in several places. Users can chat with Qodo directly inside pull requests, discuss findings, and use 'Fix with Chat Agent' to remediate issues in conversation. The Agentic Toolbox plugins also let users drive Qodo's review and finding-resolution skills through conversational coding agents (Claude Code, Codex, Kiro). Community comments describe Qodo Command as a CLI agent but do not explicitly confirm natural-language control, so they are not cited. Missing for 10: natural-language control of configuration and admin (these use the portal or .pr_agent.toml), detailed docs on the scope of chat commands, independent hands-on corroboration of the PR chat experience.
